name: DeepSeek

env_keys.comment: API keys and configuration variables documented by the provider.

python_extra.comment: HTTP API only; no required vendor Python SDK.

requires_key.comment: Valid API key required for every request.

snippet.comment: Short description field returned with each result.

domains.comment: `site:` and `-site:` query operators; multiple sites are joined with OR.

language.comment: `lang:` query operator accepts comma-separated language codes.

date.comment: `after:` / `before:` query operators accept years or YYYY-MM-DD dates.

summary.comment: Each result has a long model-readable `summary` alongside the short snippet.

mode.comment: Single raw Search endpoint. `count` and `need_content` configure the response, not a search-quality tier.

pricing_per_1k.value: $0.75 / 1K successful nonempty Search requests; Fetch separately $0.75 / 1K
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices. Direct live guide rechecked October 21: Search 100 QPS and Fetch 25 QPS. Earlier indexed 5/5 snapshot is superseded. Direct API billing is separate from temporarily free server-side integrations, billed from October 31 16:00 UTC.

lowest_price.basis: Single documented Search rate; Fetch also $0.75 / 1K

free_tier_limits.value: No recurring direct API allowance verified; server-side tool promotion is separate
free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct. Direct live guide rechecked October 21: Search 100 QPS and Fetch 25 QPS. Earlier indexed 5/5 snapshot is superseded. Direct API billing is separate from temporarily free server-side integrations, billed from October 31 16:00 UTC.

p50_latency.value: Historical July 2026: No published p50/p90/p95 Search latency
p50_latency.comment: Historical evidence retained from July 2026; not remeasured or claimed current. The guide publishes QPS limits and per-request pricing, not latency percentiles.

notes: Raw Search API (`POST /v1/tools/search`) is in both SDKs. Domain, language and date filters use DeepSeek's documented query operators; `need_content` maps to `include_content`.

api_status.comment: Direct live guide rechecked October 21: Search 100 QPS and Fetch 25 QPS. Earlier indexed 5/5 snapshot is superseded. Direct API billing is separate from temporarily free server-side integrations, billed from October 31 16:00 UTC.

native_api.value: Raw JSON POST /v1/tools/search; 1–50 results, optional content, summaries; site/lang/date query operators. Separate Markdown Fetch API.
native_api.comment: Direct live guide rechecked October 21: Search 100 QPS and Fetch 25 QPS. Earlier indexed 5/5 snapshot is superseded. Direct API billing is separate from temporarily free server-side integrations, billed from October 31 16:00 UTC.

rate_limits.value: Search 100 QPS/account; Fetch 25 QPS/account; Fetch also per-domain throttled
rate_limits.comment: Direct live guide rechecked October 21: Search 100 QPS and Fetch 25 QPS. Earlier indexed 5/5 snapshot is superseded. Direct API billing is separate from temporarily free server-side integrations, billed from October 31 16:00 UTC.

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run. Direct live guide rechecked October 21: Search 100 QPS and Fetch 25 QPS. Earlier indexed 5/5 snapshot is superseded. Direct API billing is separate from temporarily free server-side integrations, billed from October 31 16:00 UTC.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.
